title: Famous Las Vegas Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This two-hour private sightseeing tour is offered daily. Advanced reservations are required. It includes pick up at your hotel within 10-miles of the Las Vegas strip, or our designated pick-up location is the Mandalay Bay Hotel Lobby.

A few of the famous sites include The Bellagio Water Fountain and Show, The Paris Hotel, The neon castle of the Excalibur Hotel, The High Roller, The Luxury glittering and ancient Roman styled Forums at Caesar's Palace, The Pyramid Luxor Hotel & Casino, the Las Vegas Eiffel Tower, the Las Vegas Sign and so much more. This tour includes complimentary snacks, bottled water, transportation, and a professional Tour Guide Extraordinaire to accompany you throughout.
